_comment: WS4 centerM sweep — small-M + small-S + centerM>1 hypothesis. centerM is now the outer-mass multiplier (total simulated mass / inner observable mass); particles scale linearly so centerM=3 adds ~2x more outer particles at same density. Selection by minimum chi2/dof vs Pantheon+. chi2_lcdm~0.436 / chi2_eds~0.843 are reference benchmarks only, NOT the selection target.
